component.name: Video Renamer
component.summary: Preview and rename videos, rip discs with MakeMKV

description.p: Open a folder of videos, preview each one inside the app and rename it while you watch. You can also rename many files at once with a pattern.

ul.li: Playback with libmpv, including Dolby TrueHD/Atmos, DTS-HD, 4K HEVC and HDR
Rip discs with MakeMKV, keeping only the tracks you tick
Match titles and names with TheDiscDB
Export finished folders to a NAS with rsync, checked after copying

description.p: Ripping needs MakeMKV and MKVToolNix, and exporting needs rsync, installed on the computer.
Packages for pacman and Flatpak, and an app icon.
MakeMKV key errors are explained, and a key can be registered from Settings.
Export several folders, copied one at a time.
